event_text: "We begin bombing in five minutes": United States President Ronald Reagan, while running for re-election, jokes while preparing to make his weekly Saturday address on National Public Radio.
headline: Reagan Jokes About Bombing Russia on Live Microphone
story: Barry cocked his head, watching the scene unfold below. 'Seems President Reagan is getting ready for his weekly radio address, Susan. 1984, and he's running for re-election, so naturally, he's trying to warm up the old vocal cords.' Susan peered down, her beak tilted. 'And what's coming out of those vocal cords, precisely?' Barry's expression turned wry. 'Oh, just a little joke about starting a nuclear war with the Soviets. You know, the usual – "We begin bombing in five minutes" – ha ha, laughs all around, I'm sure.' Susan's feathers ruffled in the breeze. 'I do hope someone tells him that's not actually funny, Barry. The man does have access to nuclear codes, after all.' Barry snorted. 'Well, I'm sure it's all just a bit of harmless humour. I mean, what could possibly go wrong, eh?'
regret_line: Perhaps a career in stand-up comedy wasn't his true calling.
winner_line: The people who installed panic buttons in the Kremlin that week.
